body:
## Pull request overview

Enables editing the view description in `ViewConfigPanel` by replacing the previous read-only render with a controlled `<Input>` that updates `draft.description` via the existing `updateDraft → onViewUpdate` pipeline, and updates tests accordingly.

**Changes:**
- Replace the description `<span>` with an editable `<Input>` bound to `draft.description`.
- Use `objectDef.description` (or a fallback i18n string) as the description input placeholder.
- Update/extend tests to assert placeholder behavior and verify `onViewUpdate` is called on edit.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/components/ViewConfigPanel.tsx | Makes the description row editable via an `<Input>` wired to draft updates. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx | Updates assertions to match input/placeholder rendering and adds an edit interaction test. |

The new description <Input> isn’t programmatically associated with the row label (ConfigRow renders the label as a <span>, not a <label>), so screen readers may announce it as an unlabeled textbox. Add an accessible name (e.g., aria-label/aria-labelledby with a stable id) consistent with how the title field should be handled.
